methodology.headline: Equal-weight mean of family success rates on answerable episodes only; abstentions on answerable tasks are failures.
methodology.configuration_separation: scoring_version + policy + config_id + model + harness + complete condition object
methodology.legacy_scoring: Records without scoring_version are labelled legacy-unspecified and never pooled with explicitly versioned scoring results.
methodology.missing_metrics: Each metric mean includes only records with that numeric field; its n is reported. Missing rates use null.
